dedupe_keys.name: energienetze berlin wfs city areas within 250 m of a district heating or gas network

description: This Berlin data set, from the Senate Department for Economics, Energy and Public Enterprises, gives area-based information on parts of the city that lie within a maximum distance of 250 m from a district heating or gas network. It is published as a WFS service from the Berlin geodata infrastructure and listed in the Berlin open data register, harvested from the FIS-Broker, with metadata last modified on 27 August 2026. The description states that a line-accurate display of the networks is not possible because of data protection requirements, so the layer is a proximity zone, not pipe routes. Coverage is the city of Berlin. Access is free through the WFS under the Data Licence Germany Zero 2.0. Caveats: zones indicate proximity only, not the network operator, capacity, age or whether a connection is feasible. Simulation uses are screening which city areas could be served by existing heat or gas networks for heat planning, and approximate exposure of network corridors. Related records: data-stromnetz-berlin-network-structure-data covers the Berlin electricity distribution network, and data-district-heating-benchmark-berlin gives synthetic district heating instances.
